name: recipe-picker-mcp
description: MCP Recipe Picker - progressive demo: Gateway (Part 1) and Runtime (Part 2)

scripts.deploy:gateway: cd gateway && sam build && sam deploy
scripts.build:runtime: npx esbuild runtime/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=runtime/dist/server.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
